chars.DAUGHTER: a Moroccan young woman about 22, long dark wavy hair, wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.MOTHER: a Moroccan woman in her fifties, wearing an emerald-green djellaba, a beige headscarf and gold bracelets
chars.WORKER: a young Moroccan tiler about 25, short black hair, wearing a dusty grey t-shirt, navy work trousers with black knee pads and an orange cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside an unfinished modern villa with half-tiled walls and tile boxes on the floor. Seen from a doorway, head-to-waist: the DAUGHTER angrily snatches a smartphone out of her MOTHER's raised hand mid-motion, the MOTHER's mouth open in shock. Both faces clearly visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close shot: a smartphone flying and falling to the dusty tiled floor of the unfinished villa, the MOTHER behind it staring down with wide shocked eyes, hand still raised.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the unfinished villa room, the DAUGHTER shouting furiously at her MOTHER, leaning forward, hands open; the MOTHER steps back stunned. Medium shot, faces in the centre, bags of tile adhesive in the background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The DAUGHTER points a finger at her MOTHER with a threatening, defiant look, as if saying she will tell the father something; the MOTHER freezes, guilty and scared. Medium shot in the half-tiled villa room.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The WORKER stands awkwardly against a half-tiled wall holding a tile trowel, looking toward the viewer with a confused, embarrassed expression, eyebrows raised, as if asking what he should do. Medium shot, comic mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The DAUGHTER keeps shouting at her MOTHER, arms spread wide in anger, demanding why she followed her; the MOTHER looks away. Medium shot, warm afternoon light from an unglazed window opening of the villa.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The MOTHER sits on an upturned bucket in the unfinished villa, crying and slapping her own forehead with her hand; in the background the WORKER quietly slips out through the doorway on tiptoe, carrying his tool bag.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small simple bedroom in a Moroccan city: the WORKER sits up on his bed startled and nervous, staring at car headlights shining through the window curtain. Medium shot, face visible in the centre.
